title: Junior AI NLP Engineer
raw_text: The engineering team builds intelligent document search and conversational assistance features for business customers. The team currently consists of 9 engineers including backend developers, machine learning engineers, QA specialists, and a product manager working together to deliver production AI services. This position is intended for an early career engineer who wants to gain hands-on experience with modern NLP systems while contributing to customer-facing products. Daily work includes implementing API endpoints with FastAPI, integrating Transformer models from Hugging Face, creating embedding pipelines for semantic search, supporting Retrieval Augmented Generation workflows using LangChain, and writing automated tests for AI services. The engineer will also troubleshoot model performance, improve prompt templates, and collaborate with senior engineers to evaluate retrieval quality. The technical stack includes Python, FastAPI, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, ChromaDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, and basic AWS services. Preferred exposure includes Redis and FAISS but these are not mandatory. Success within the first six months means independently delivering production features, contributing code reviews, improving retrieval quality for business documents, and participating confidently in sprint planning. The role collaborates closely with product managers, QA engineers, backend developers, and data specialists while offering opportunities to learn production AI engineering practices and gradually take ownership of complete RAG features.
responsibilities: Develop FastAPI services for NLP features
Collaborate with QA and product teams
requirements: At least 1 year of Python experience
Understanding of embeddings and RAG concepts
education_requirement: Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related field

title: Senior AI Platform and NLP Engineer
raw_text: The platform engineering organization develops enterprise scale language model infrastructure powering search, knowledge management, and intelligent automation products. The team consists of more than 30 engineers across machine learning, backend infrastructure, platform reliability, and product management. The successful candidate will lead architecture decisions for production Retrieval Augmented Generation systems, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and collaborate with leadership on technical strategy. Daily work includes designing LangChain and LangGraph workflows, optimizing embedding generation and vector databases, deploying Transformer models with Kubernetes, implementing evaluation frameworks, reviewing system performance, and guiding cloud infrastructure improvements across AWS environments. The stack includes Python, PyTorch, Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, Pinecone, Milvus, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, CI/CD, Redis, and enterprise observability tooling. Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and scalable production AI systems is required. Success during the first six months includes delivering a reliable enterprise RAG platform, improving latency and retrieval metrics, mentoring engineers, and influencing long-term architecture. The role works closely with product leadership, security, platform engineering, data engineering, and customer success teams. Strong technical leadership provides opportunities to shape engineering direction, influence AI governance, and drive adoption of advanced language technologies across multiple products.
requirements: Minimum 6 years of AI engineering experience
education_requirement: Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field

title: Associate MLOps Engineer

The role works closely with data scientists, platform engineers, QA specialists, and product managers while providing opportunities to expand responsibility into model serving architecture and production automation.
requirements: Experience with MLflow or model deployment
